sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: A diverse group of professionals, residents, and others will share their individual stories, taking stock of what is happening in the city more than a year after the fires. An accompanying exhibition will explore interventions at the Wildland-Urban Interface (WUI) and the boundary conditions working between the scales of architecture, urbanism, and the rural landscape. The exhibition highlights the student work of David Eugin Moon of N H D M at the Columbia University Graduate School of Architecture, Planning and Preservation.
